tests.name: cbor_scalar_run_basic_array
tests.intent: Verify parsing of a contiguous CBOR definite-length array of unsigned integers via from_cbor.

tests.name: cbor_scalar_run_negative_integers
tests.intent: Verify parsing of CBOR negative integers inside a scalar array run.

tests.name: cbor_scalar_run_booleans_null
tests.intent: Verify parsing of booleans and null values in a CBOR scalar run.

tests.name: cbor_scalar_run_floats
tests.intent: Verify parsing of float and double values inside a CBOR scalar run.

tests.name: cbor_scalar_run_mixed_types
tests.intent: Verify mixed scalar array elements (ints, negative ints, bools, null, floats) in a single run.

tests.name: cbor_scalar_run_mixed_with_containers
tests.intent: Verify that a scalar run correctly hands over non-scalar elements (nested arrays/objects) to parse_cbor_value.

tests.name: cbor_scalar_run_non_contiguous_stream
tests.intent: Verify that non-contiguous stream inputs bypass the scalar run optimization correctly.

tests.name: cbor_scalar_run_truncated_input
tests.intent: Verify behavior when a scalar run array is truncated mid-stream.

tests.name: cbor_scalar_run_empty_array
tests.intent: Verify parsing of an empty definite-length CBOR array.

tests.name: cbor_scalar_run_sax_events
tests.intent: Verify SAX event sequence and absence of source strings during scalar array parsing.

tests.name: cbor_scalar_run_large_integers
tests.intent: Verify parsing of 2, 4, and 8-byte integers in a CBOR scalar run.

tests.name: cbor_scalar_run_nested_arrays
tests.intent: Verify behavior when an array contains scalar runs followed by nested arrays.

tests.name: cbor_scalar_run_negative_large_integers
tests.intent: Verify parsing of 1, 2, 4, and 8-byte negative integers in a CBOR scalar run.

tests.name: cbor_scalar_run_objects_inside_array
tests.intent: Verify that objects inside a CBOR array interrupt the scalar run and parse correctly.

tests.name: cbor_scalar_run_strings_inside_array
tests.intent: Verify that text strings inside a CBOR array stop the scalar run and are parsed via standard fallback.

tests.name: cbor_scalar_run_indefinite_array
tests.intent: Verify indefinite-length CBOR arrays bypass the scalar run optimization.

tests.name: cbor_scalar_run_exact_buffer_boundary
tests.intent: Verify boundary check where remaining bytes are slightly fewer than 9 bytes.

tests.name: cbor_scalar_run_single_element
tests.intent: Verify parsing of a definite-length array containing a single scalar element.

tests.name: cbor_scalar_run_sax_early_bailout
tests.intent: Verify SAX parser returning false during a scalar run terminates parsing cleanly.

tests.name: cbor_scalar_run_nested_scalar_runs
tests.intent: Verify multiple nested definite-length arrays containing scalar runs.

tests.name: test_cbor_array_one_byte_length
tests.intent: Exercise definite-length CBOR array with a one-byte length marker (0x98 followed by 1-byte length), routing through enter_cbor_array.

tests.name: test_cbor_scalar_run_booleans_null_floats
tests.intent: Exercise parse_cbor_scalar_run handling booleans (0xF4, 0xF5), null (0xF6), single-precision float (0xFA), and double-precision float (0xFB).

tests.name: test_cbor_scalar_run_negative_fixint
tests.intent: Exercise parse_cbor_scalar_run handling small negative integers (fixint range 0x20 to 0x37).

tests.name: test_cbor_scalar_run_sax_rejection
tests.intent: Exercise sax parser returning false during parse_cbor_scalar_run, verifying it returns false cleanly.

tests.name: test_cbor_float_simple_constants
tests.intent: Exercise float constant values 0xFB (-1.0), 0xFC (0.0), 0xFD (1.0) and half float conversion via binary reader.

tests.name: cbor_scalar_run_floats_fixed
tests.intent: Verify parsing of float and double values inside a CBOR scalar run.

tests.name: test_cbor_scalar_run_sax_rejection_fixed
tests.intent: Exercise sax parser returning false during parse_cbor_scalar_run, verifying it returns false cleanly.

tests.name: test_cbor_scalar_run_sax_rejection_fixed_fixed
tests.intent: Exercise sax parser returning false during parse_cbor_scalar_run, verifying it returns false cleanly.
